picks.editorial_note: An AI model (Omnii) designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a landmark proof that generative AI can produce a functioning biological therapeutic, not just predict one.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's ML-based imaging technique independently confirmed the iconic Event Horizon Telescope black hole image in a Nature publication, giving AI a validated role in one of astrophysics' most famous results.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena — from sand to folding proteins — in a single deep-learning architecture, a meaningful step toward general-purpose physical simulation.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a national-security-linked espionage scandal triggered a US government investigation, with major implications for AI hardware supply chains and policy scrutiny of the industry's leadership.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: A $53 million ARPA-H award to an MIT-led team to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives is a substantial federal bet on AI-driven chemical discovery with direct agricultural and health relevance.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize research in physical AI, agentic AI, and robotics signals a significant industry-academia push toward sovereign European AI industrial capacity.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, anchored by a planned joint laboratory, pairs a major research university with a leading commercial robotics firm to advance embodied AI.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU's 'Workspace Models' give robots a new, cheaper way to recall past observations for learning complex skills, addressing a real bottleneck in robot learning.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo's ZEBRA-Prop lightens the computational cost of predicting material properties from language-model representations, a practical advance for AI-accelerated materials science.
picks.title: 言語モデルを用いた材料物性の予測を軽量化 | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学

picks.editorial_note: MIT's new quantization method targets the KV cache memory bottleneck in large language models, a NeurIPS-bound result with direct implications for making LLM inference faster and cheaper at scale.
picks.title: Faster data compression through quantization
